:::{#def-measurable-space}
#### Measurable space

A **measurable space**
[@wikipedia_measurable_space]
$(S, \salg)$
is a set $S$ together with a [$\sigma$-algebra](#def-sigma-algebra) $\salg$ on $S$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-measurable-set}
#### Measurable set

In a [measurable space](#def-measurable-space) $(S, \salg)$,
the sets in $\salg$ are its **measurable sets**.

:::
